'''Cryogenic cells''' were [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] used to store large amounts of energy needed to power a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] utilized them as the primary power cells on their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" />
